patterns: 'X but it's 197x' is the format of the month: techhalla's 'Men in Black but it's 1977' led the day at 31.9K views / 832 likes - a one-line title, 70s film look, zero tool talk (after Pirates 1974 and Futurama 1971 on 15.11).

Weekly 'AI got insanely visual' roundups keep working: minchoi's '10 wild examples' thread (robot, fly-around home run, relightable rooms) hit 19.0K; his Jensen Huang/NVIDIA news post 16.0K and 'Grok Bot ad on The Sphere' 8.4K.
Model A/B tests get bookmarks: AIWarper's H3 Image LoRA (analog photo dataset, base vs 2000 steps) 7.8K and 'Seedream 5.5 is quite nice' 7.3K.

Tool-for-filmmakers posts clear the floor: EHuanglu on Taan (AI music that follows video cuts/timestamps) 5.8K; azed_ai's Prompt Share (minimalist cartoon characters) 5.8K and ElevenLabs video captions 5.2K.

maxescu's serialized 'Adventures of Kekius Maximus' (4 episodes in one day) stayed under 4.1K: episodic drops split the reach. Outsider sample was thin; Kling 4.0 vs Seedance 2.5 same-prompt comparisons keep showing up.
